Authentic premium gardening magazine photography, tactile natural materials, sharp believable plant details, no heavy blur, no text or logo, no paper collage or graphics. Landscape 3:2 composition, entire pot and hands comfortably inside central 70 percent so it can crop to square or portrait; neither cut off at edges.
